summary: Iteration 68 - Security Fix & Sales Portal features tested. Backend: 17/17 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security and Sales Portal features tested: (1) Google Auth security - new users get pending status, pending_approval=true in response, auto-creates guest record, suspended users get 403. (2) Login security - pending users get 403. (3) Sales portal login at /sales-portal with last_name + PIN authentication via /api/auth/sales-portal-login. (4) StaffRoute guard in App.js wraps main Layout, redirects Guest/pending users to /portal. (5) Portal dashboard shows badge and PDF download buttons. (6) Kiosk lock has no exit points (Setup, Logout, Exit links not visible). (7) PortalDashboard variable names fixed (c for check-ins, e for events).

google_auth_security.notes: Requires session_id, invalid session returns 401, new users get pending status with pending_approval=true, auto-creates guest record, suspended users get 403

login_security.notes: Pending users get 403 with message about pending approval

sales_portal_login.notes: Requires last_name + PIN, validates both fields, returns 401 for invalid credentials

sales_portal_ui.notes: Login form with last_name and PIN inputs, Log In button, all data-testid attributes present

staff_route_guard.notes: Wraps main Layout in App.js, redirects Guest/pending users to /portal

portal_dashboard.notes: Shows badge section with UnifiedBadge, Download Profile PDF button, Edit My Profile button, stats cards

kiosk_lock.notes: No exit points visible (Setup, Logout, Exit links not present)

portal_dashboard_variable_fix.notes: Variable names corrected: c for check-ins (line 95), e for events (line 120)

admin_pages.notes: All major pages load correctly for admin users
